supported: AND predicates with supported typed literals
Explicitly cleared unbounded time with no grain or comparison
Stable SQL output identities and separate display labels
Structural result proof with exact actual column order and completeness gate
unsupported: Bounded time / DATETIME literals until storage-timezone contract is proven
Multi-subject metric with no proven query subject
Governed SQL alias policy or unrepresentable projection order
Dataset-local/metadata/analytics/report backends are not silently routed to query ASL
remaining_result_gates: Actual execution receipt and source snapshot
Real result columns/rows and business correctness
Ordering/cardinality/calendar requirements for currently unsupported payloads
